content: पिप्पलः .²1 The holy fig-tree (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>पिंपळ</ns>); <ls>Y. 1. 302</ls>. .²2 A nipple. .²3 The sleeve of a jacket or coat. .²4 A bird kept free (not confined in a cage). .{@-लम्@} .²1 A berry in general. .²2 A berry of the holy fig-tree. .²3 Sensual enjoyment; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 4. 8</ls>. .²4 Water. .²5 The effect arising from acts (कर्मजन्यफल); <ls>Muṇḍ. 3. 1. 1</ls>; एकस्तयोः खादति पिप्पलान्नमन्यो निरन्नोऽपि बलेन भूयान् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 11. 6</ls>.
